props.heading: Healing with Heart, Insight, and Authentic Expertise
props.body:
Mark is the founder of Health Renovation and a deeply experienced wholistic practitioner. With a rare combination of clinical knowledge, intuitive insight, and genuine care, he creates personalised treatment plans for every client.

His approach is centred on treating the whole person – not just isolated symptoms – integrating Kinesiology, Homeopathy, Massage, Reiki, Life Coaching, and MRT-Detox into personalised treatment plans.
props.quote: "Put yourself first – your health is the foundation of everything."

items.q: How often do I need to come for treatments?
items.a: Treatment frequency depends on your individual needs and health goals. For acute conditions, weekly sessions are often recommended initially. For general wellbeing and maintenance, fortnightly or monthly visits work well. Mark will advise a personalised schedule after your first session.

items.q: What is muscle testing and how does it work in Kinesiology?
items.a: Muscle testing (or applied kinesiology) uses gentle resistance applied to a muscle – usually an arm or leg – to assess the body's response to various stimuli. The muscle response gives Mark information about which body systems are stressed or imbalanced, allowing him to identify the most effective treatments. It's non-invasive, safe, and surprisingly accurate.

items.q: Can you help with anxiety and sleep issues?
items.a: Absolutely. Stress, anxiety, and poor sleep are among the most common presentations. Kinesiology, Reiki, and Homeopathy in particular are very effective for calming the nervous system, reducing cortisol, and restoring healthy sleep patterns. Many clients notice significant improvement within a few sessions.

items.q: Do I need a referral from my doctor?
items.a: No referral is needed. You can book directly with Mark by calling or texting 0412 567 614. That said, these therapies work best as a complement to your existing medical care, not a replacement. Mark encourages open communication with your GP.

items.q: Is there parking available at the Hawthorn clinic?
items.a: Yes, street parking is available nearby. Mark will provide specific directions and parking details when you book your appointment.

items.q: What should I wear or bring to my first session?
items.a: Wear comfortable, loose-fitting clothing. For Kinesiology and Massage, you may need to remove shoes or outer layers. Bring any relevant medical history, current medications, or notes about your health concerns. Most importantly, bring an open mind!
